caption: The drawing depicts a single duck in profile, facing left, against a plain, light beige background with no additional objects or scenery. The duck has a rounded head that is brown with darker brown and reddish brown mottling, and a long, slightly downward-sloping bill that is dark gray with bluish and brownish tones. The eye is distinctly marked with a lighter ring around it. The neck and chest area are dark brown to black. The body is predominantly gray with small, intricate patterns suggesting texture on the duck’s feathers, transitioning to a lighter, almost whitish gray underbelly. The wing is neatly folded along the body and is marked by darker gray shading and black on the tips. The tail is short and black, blending into the rest of the body. There are no other elements or colors in the composition apart from the duck and the background.
title: Decoy Duck #1
